title: Glimmer lights appear after a kind act

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Look, the meadow is sparkling after we helped each other!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Our patience made the lights appear, just like gentle magic!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: I never knew waiting could create such wonderful wonder!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Now every gentle act can bring bright glimmers for all!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Let’s share this glow with all our friends tonight!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Together we’ll keep the meadow shining forever and ever!
